scheme_name: Pre-Matric Scholarships to the Children of Those Engaged in Occupations Involving Cleaning and Prone to Health Hazards
other_conditions: Applicant must be a child or ward of an Indian national whose parent/guardian belongs to one of the following occupations: tanner, flayer, waste picker, manual scavenger, or engaged in hazardous cleaning as defined under the Manual Scavengers Act 2013.
Student may not take up employment or assist parents in their work during the period of study.
Student must maintain regular attendance as determined by the competent school authority.
Scholarship will be discontinued if the student fails to secure annual promotion unless unavoidable reasons are certified by the Head of the Institution.
Scholarship may be suspended or cancelled for violation of school discipline or any other terms and conditions of the scheme.
Migration from one institution to another during the academic year is not normally allowed except under exceptional circumstances.
Beneficiary is not allowed to avail benefits under any other pre‑matric scholarship scheme.
Student must be enrolled in class 1st‑10th (day scholars) or class 3rd‑10th (hostellers).
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly scholarship of ₹110 for day scholars (class 1‑10) and ₹700 for hostellers (class 3‑10) for ten months, plus ad‑hoc grants and additional allowances for students with disabilities.
